temperature_model_family: HGB absolute_error; same four-region development folds; no outside-fold target features
capacity_rule: Among ASOS solar candidates passing all original six gates, use the smallest iteration count within 0.5% of the lowest MAE. Extend further only if doubling still yields at least 0.5% lower MAE.
seed_rule: Repeat the 1200-iteration ASOS solar model at seeds 20261025 and 20261026; compare their range and the fixed mean of all three seeds. Never select the best individual seed. If a different capacity is adopted, disclose that the seed experiment covers 1200 only.
ensembles: equal mean of combined ASOS solar MAE1200 at all three fixed seeds
equal mean of combined ASOS solar MAE1200 and non-solar combined history MAE1200
equal mean of combined ASOS solar MAE1200 and MAE2400
ensemble_rule: Require all original gates and at least 0.5% lower MAE than the chosen simpler ASOS solar model to pay the extra model inference cost. No fitted weights.
icing_rule: Only replace v2 if the predeclared nested classification candidate passes F1 gain, precision, recall, both winters, every station and event-retention gates. Otherwise retain the separate v2 reference temperature and disclose that it differs from current regression output.
assessment_scope: Repeated development on the same allowed 9 stations, not new independent evaluation. Practical saturation in tested directions is not proof that no improvement exists.
